description:
Query the SWATGenX PFAS monitoring inventory (agency monitoring stations + observations):
    only sources whose licence allows serving them, the same set as the PFAS data API; unaudited
    VLM packs are excluded. Filter by two-letter `state` (e.g. 'MI') and/or `analyte` (e.g.
    'PFOS', 'PFOA'): with an analyte, only stations that have at least one observation of it are
    returned, each with its latest recorded value (media, n_samples, n_detect, max_value,
    latest_value, latest_date, detection band). Units follow the medium: water / groundwater /
    porewater values are ng/L; sediment, soil and tissue are mass-based (ug/kg-class), so values
    are comparable across stations only within one `media`. Each answer counts toward the account's
    monthly allowance of distinct stations (a station already returned this month does not count
    again) and 200 new stations a day; `metering` in the reply reports the account's count. For research/screening use; not a regulatory data source.
name: query_pfas
title: Query PFAS monitoring (US or worldwide)
